asA: stage-keeper on the PR branch before the merge
iWant: rcf build finalise to write complete when the last round's REVIEW, TEST and test-strength records hold at the reviewed head
soThat: the merge carries complete and no verify report is ever needed inside the cycle
description: The last-round checks and the success line.
title: The stage-keeper finalises a spec to complete from the last round's verdicts

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture branch holding FBS-001 (inProgress) scoping AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 with Code Nodes, commits DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (ReviewVerdict MERGE/PASS at H touching both), TEST: (TestVerdict PASS at H and a passing test-strength record at H), and no rcf/verify-reports/ directory at all, when rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run run-7 runs, then it exits 0, stdout is "finalise: FBS-001 complete at <head7> (reviewed <H7>, ci run-7, touched 2 criteria)", rcf/fbs/fbs-001.json reads executionStatus "complete", and nothing else in the tree changes.

[failure] Given the same fixture with no REVIEW: commit, Finalise exits 4 with stderr "finalise refused: no REVIEW verdict for FBS-001 on the branch"; given a REVIEW verdict code MERGE with adequacy FINDINGS, it exits 4 with "finalise refused: REVIEW at <H7> is MERGE/FINDINGS; a failed verdict closes the round".

[failure] Given the happy fixture with the TEST: commit absent, Finalise exits 4 with stderr "finalise refused: no TEST verdict at <H7>"; given a TestVerdict FAIL at H, it exits 4 with "finalise refused: TEST at <H7> is FAIL"; given a TEST PASS at H followed by a TEST: commit adding a FAIL TestVerdict at a later head M, it exits 4 with "finalise refused: TEST at <M7> is FAIL; a failed verdict closes the round".

[failure] Given the happy fixture plus a "BUILD: late fix" commit after the TEST: commit, Finalise exits 4 with stderr "finalise refused: REVIEW reopened by <s7> BUILD: after the reviewed head <H7>"; a "DEFINE: amend" after H refuses the same way, while extra FINALISE: commits inside FINALISE classes (a clean merge of main, a lockfile) do not refuse.

[edge] Given the happy fixture finalised once (FBS-001 complete), when rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run run-7 runs again at the same head or after a further FINALISE: commit, then it exits 0, stdout is "finalise: FBS-001 complete (unchanged)" and rcf/fbs/fbs-001.json is byte-identical; given an earlier round (REVIEW FINDINGS, then DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: MERGE/PASS, TEST: PASS), Finalise judges only the last round and exits 0.

[edge] Given the happy fixture with a "FINALISE: merge main" commit after the TEST: commit whose resolution is clean, Finalise run with --merge-suite <a green BaseSuiteRecord whose head is that merge commit M> exits 0 and stderr carries "[info] finalise: merge from main after the reviewed head; base suite green at <M7> is the suite evidence, ci run-7 on <head7>"; given a two-spec round whose ReviewVerdict fbsIds are ["FBS-001", "FBS-002"], finalising each spec writes complete on that spec only.
[must-not] On every refusal, rcf build finalise leaves rcf/fbs/<fbs-id>.json byte-identical and git status --porcelain unchanged, and never writes complete on any spec other than the one named.

[failure] Given the happy fixture plus a clean "FINALISE: merge main" at M after the TEST: commit, rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run run-7 without --merge-suite exits 4 with stderr "finalise refused: merge from main after the reviewed head; pass --merge-suite <a green base-suite record at <M7>>"; with a record whose head is not M it exits 4 with "finalise refused: base suite recorded at <x7>, merge head is <M7>"; with a red record at M it exits 4 with "finalise refused: base suite red at <M7>; the verifier records TEST FAIL at the merge head"; a FINALISE: status commit with no merge needs no --merge-suite; every refusal leaves rcf/fbs/fbs-001.json byte-identical.

[failure] Given the happy fixture with FBS-001 at notStarted, rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run run-7 exits 4 with stderr "finalise refused: FBS-001 is notStarted; the round's DEFINE: marks it inProgress" and writes nothing; at inProgress it writes complete; at complete or verified it runs as an amend round.
